```{r}
cts <- c(
  "Alveolar 1", "Alveolar 2", "Adventitial", "Inflammatory", "SMCs",
  "Senescence-like", "Proliferating"
)


degs_path <- "/fs/ess/PAS2148/huchen/fibroblasts_data/Cultured_DEGs.xlsx"

create_volcano_plot <- function(
    data,
    x_col        = "logfoldchanges",
    p_col        = "pvals_adj",
    score_col    = "scores",
    gene_col     = "names",
    logFC_thresh = 1,
    p_thresh     = 0.05,
    y_cap        = 300,
    compress_at  = 280,
    compress_to  = 20,
    label_top_n  = 15,
    label_genes  = NULL,
    x_label      = "Log2(fold change)",
    y_label      = "-Log10(adjusted p-value)"
) {
  
  pvals <- data[[p_col]]
  pvals[is.na(pvals)] <- NA
  pvals[pvals == 0] <- 10^(-y_cap)
  
  y_raw <- -log10(pvals)
  y_capped <- pmin(y_raw, y_cap)
  
  y_plot <- ifelse(
    y_capped <= compress_at,
    y_capped / compress_at * compress_to,
    compress_to + (y_capped - compress_at)
  )
  
  threshold_raw <- -log10(p_thresh)
  threshold_y_plot <- ifelse(
    threshold_raw <= compress_at,
    threshold_raw / compress_at * compress_to,
    compress_to + (threshold_raw - compress_at)
  )
  
  data$color_group <- dplyr::case_when(
    data[[x_col]] >  logFC_thresh & data[[p_col]] < p_thresh ~ "Upregulated",
    data[[x_col]] < -logFC_thresh & data[[p_col]] < p_thresh ~ "Downregulated",
    TRUE ~ "Not significant"
  )
  
  plot_data <- data.frame(
    x = data[[x_col]],
    y = y_plot,
    y_original = y_capped,
    score = data[[score_col]],
    gene = data[[gene_col]],
    color_group = data$color_group,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y) & !is.na(color_group))
  
  label_subset <- NULL
  
  if (!is.null(label_top_n) && label_top_n > 0) {
    top_up <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(color_group == "Upregulated") |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(y_original), dplyr::desc(score)) |>
      dplyr::slice_head(n = label_top_n)
    
    top_down <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(color_group == "Downregulated") |>
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(y_original), score) |>
      dplyr::slice_head(n = label_top_n)
    
    label_subset <- dplyr::bind_rows(top_up, top_down)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(label_genes)) {
    manual_genes <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(gene %in% label_genes)
    
    label_subset <- dplyr::bind_rows(label_subset, manual_genes) |>
      dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
  }
  
  y_breaks_original <- c(0, 100, 200, 290, 300)
  y_breaks_plot <- ifelse(
    y_breaks_original <= compress_at,
    y_breaks_original / compress_at * compress_to,
    compress_to + (y_breaks_original - compress_at)
  )
  
  y_max_plot <- compress_to + (y_cap - compress_at)
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = color_group)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-logFC_thresh, logFC_thresh),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "gray40",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = threshold_y_plot,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "gray40",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "#cb5f51",
        "Downregulated" = "#6292ca",
        "Not significant" = "gray70"
      ),
      breaks = c("Upregulated", "Downregulated", "Not significant")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_max_plot + 3),
      breaks = y_breaks_plot,
      labels = y_breaks_original,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = y_label,
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  if (!is.null(label_subset) && nrow(label_subset) > 0) {
    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_subset,
      aes(label = gene),
      size = 3,
      segment.color = "gray30",
      segment.size = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  return(p)
}

for (ct in cts) {
  print(ct)
  degs_ct <- read_excel(degs_path, sheet = ct)
  
  p <- create_volcano_plot(
    data         = degs_ct,
    x_col        = "logfoldchanges",
    p_col        = "pvals_adj",
    gene_col     = "names",
    logFC_thresh = 1,
    p_thresh     = 0.05,
    label_top_n  = 10,
    compress_at = 290,
    compress_to = 6
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(save.path, paste0(ct, "_Volcano.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 5,
    height = 4,
    units = "in"
  )
  print(p)
}
  
```
